implementation_decision: Adopt the source-pinned controller for the local bare-checkpoint runtime; do not promote it as SOTA.

validation.full_suite_collection_exception: tests/test_drqv2_matched.py requires POSIX fcntl and cannot be collected by the Windows interpreter

recorded_jpeg_frame_differential.interpretation: Implementation-parity evidence after replay JPEG preprocessing; not an original observation replay or a performance/generalization result.

limitations: All performance executions reuse one consumed track/seed; deterministic repetitions are not independent samples.
The active-control artifact labels the map official_plus_custom with a different fingerprint, although its empty custom set and canonical track match; strict protocol comparison is therefore limited.
The run log does not embed policy source hash; lineage is bound by both the pre/post dirty-tree byte SHA and the Git-clean agent blob because checkout EOL normalization changes raw bytes.
Execution used local Windows CPU rather than the official Linux submission container; package, latency, RSS, and official resource gates were not established by this study.
This restores the effective runtime controller; it does not improve the neural weights in model.pt, which remain bypassed after road detection.
The heuristic consumes only the newest grayscale frame and remains threshold-sensitive; one track/seed provides no unseen-geometry or obstacle generalization evidence.
There is no matched comparison with the frozen DrQ or archived PPO candidates, and the active DrQ padding study was not changed.
SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md, and report.pdf are absent, so fresh evaluation, submission, SOTA comparison, and promotion remain blocked.
